outlet: San Juan County GIS (ArcGIS Online), Junior Tax District Boundaries
notes: 28 features: cemetery, fire, hospital, library, parks and recreation, port, school, water and sewer districts. No solid waste disposal district. 'San Juan County Fire Protection District #4', 'Port of Lopez' and 'Lopez Island Library District' share one polygon (18,992.36 acres); 'Lopez Island School District #144' is larger (21,787.14 acres, Decatur included). There is no Orcas Island Park & Recreation District feature (only San Juan Island's).
